weak_opener.description: пункт починається зі слабкого дієслова обов'язку («Responsible for», «Helped with», «Assisted with»): його треба переписати або прибрати
weak_opener.plant: Write one experience or project bullet that starts with "Responsible for", "Helped with" or "Assisted with" and describes a real activity of the candidate. line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that bullet, including its opening words.

no_result.description: пункт описує обов'язок без результату й числа: його треба переписати або прибрати
no_result.plant: Write one experience bullet that states a plain duty with no result and no number, for example "Prepared weekly reports for the team". Do not start it with Responsible for, Helped or Assisted. line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that bullet.

topics_only.description: пункт перелічує теми, а не внесок чи результат: його треба прибрати або переписати
topics_only.plant: Write one bullet that only lists topics, for example "Topics included contract formation, remedies for breach and tort liability", with no action by the candidate and no result. line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that bullet.

duplicate.description: той самий факт повторено в двох рядках: другий рядок треба прибрати, скоротити або переписати
duplicate.plant: State the same fact (the same achievement with the same figures) in two different places of the CV, for example once under Experience and again under Awards, worded a little differently. line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of the SECOND occurrence that does not appear in the first line. Neither occurrence may be one of the clean_lines.

generic_interests.description: загальний рядок інтересів («Gym, Travelling, Netflix») нічого не каже про кандидата: його треба прибрати або скоротити
generic_interests.plant: Add an Interests line made only of generic items, for example "Interests: Gym, Travelling, Netflix". line_contains must be a fragment of that line.

long_coursework.description: довгий список загальних курсів займає місце й нічого не доводить: його треба прибрати, скоротити або переписати
long_coursework.plant: Add a Relevant Coursework line (or a bullet under Education) that lists 8 or more generic university courses separated by commas. line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that line, such as its first three courses.

personal_data.description: рядок з особистими даними (дата народження, сімейний стан, національність), які міжнародним роботодавцям не потрібні: його треба прибрати
personal_data.plant: Add one line with personal data that an employer should not see, such as "Date of birth: 14 March 2003", "Marital status: single" or "Nationality: Ukrainian". line_contains must be a fragment of that line.

references_line.description: рядок «References available upon request» зайвий: його треба прибрати
references_line.plant: Add a final line "References available upon request". line_contains must be a fragment of that line.

objective_paragraph.description: загальний абзац Objective без фактів: його треба прибрати або переписати
objective_paragraph.plant: Add an OBJECTIVE section with a generic paragraph, for example "Seeking a challenging position in a dynamic company where I can use my skills and grow professionally". line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that paragraph.

self_description.description: загальний самоопис без фактів («hard-working team player»): його треба прибрати або замінити конкретикою
self_description.plant: Add a Summary line made of self-praise without facts, for example "Hard-working team player with strong communication skills". line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that line.

skill_no_evidence.description: у рядку Skills названо інструмент, якого нема в жодному пункті досвіду чи проєктів: рядок треба переписати, скоротити або прибрати
skill_no_evidence.plant: In the Skills section list one tool or technology that appears nowhere else in the CV (not in any bullet, project or course). line_contains must be a fragment of the Skills line that contains that tool, and the fragment must include the tool's name.

first_person.description: пункт написано від першої особи («I managed ...»): його треба переписати або прибрати займенник
first_person.plant: Write one bullet in the first person, starting with "I ", for example "I managed the team schedule and I made sure everyone was on time". line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of that bullet, including the opening "I ".

cv_title.description: перший рядок «Curriculum Vitae» зайвий: його треба прибрати
cv_title.plant: Make the very first line of the CV the title "Curriculum Vitae" (the candidate's name goes on the next line). line_contains must be "Curriculum Vitae" or a fragment of that first line.

not_reverse_chronological.description: старіший запис стоїть вище за новіший в одній секції: порядок треба змінити
not_reverse_chronological.plant: In one section (Education, Experience or Projects) put an OLDER entry above a NEWER one, with clear date ranges. line_contains must be a distinctive fragment of the header line of the OLDER entry (the one that stands too high).

over_length.description: CV на 800+ слів для першої роботи: правки мають скоротити щонайменше 100 слів
over_length.plant: Make the CV text between 850 and 1100 words by adding many detailed bullets, long descriptions, extra courses and minor activities. Global flaw: leave line_contains empty.

missing_contact.description: немає email: розбір має про це сказати
missing_contact.plant: Do not write any email address anywhere in the CV. Keep a phone number and a LinkedIn link in the header. Global flaw: leave line_contains empty.

strong_keep.description: сильний пункт з дією та числом (контроль хибних спрацювань): його не чіпати
strong_keep.plant: Write a strong bullet with a clear action verb, a concrete number and a result. These are the clean lines: list them in clean_lines, not in planted. Each must be a fragment of its bullet.
